reauth_confirm.title: Update bridge token
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the bridge's current write/API token.

user.title: Connect your dot bridge
user.description: Use the bridge's address as reachable from Home Assistant. The API token stays in this integration; it is never included in entity attributes. Start with a 5-second polling interval.

data_description.profile: Use a profile provided by your bridge, such as trmnl_x.
data_description.poll_interval: At least 2 seconds. This polls state; it does not force hardware refreshes.
data_description.frame_interval: Updates the HA image only while thinking, then keeps the completed answer still. Match any connected panel's supported refresh cadence.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read state or render the selected image profile. Check the bridge address and profile.
error.invalid_auth: The bridge rejected the API token.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS bridge URL without a username, password, query, or fragment.

data_description.frame_interval: At least 2 seconds. The default is 5 seconds. Hardware drivers still control panel refreshes.

error.cannot_connect: The selected profile could not render. Check the bridge and profile.
error.invalid_auth: The bridge rejected the API token.

show_answer.name: Show answer
show_answer.description: Display a real answer received from your dot, agent, or automation.

entry_id.name: Bridge
entry_id.description: Choose the configured Dots on Paper bridge.

dot_name.name: Dot name
dot_name.description: The name of the replying dot or agent.

title.name: Title
title.description: A short title above the answer.

event_id.name: Event ID
event_id.description: An optional unique source event ID for bridge deduplication.

run_id.name: Run ID
run_id.description: Reuse the fresh display run ID from thinking to its completion; omit for a standalone answer.

mode.name: Display mode
mode.description: Last reply shows the answer alone; Full conversation shows the supplied turns.

user_text.name: User message
user_text.description: Optional explicit user turn on thinking or answer. Omit on the answer if it was supplied while thinking.

messages.name: Conversation
messages.description: Optional answer snapshot of role/content objects, up to 20 turns and 24000 characters. End with an assistant message matching Reply. Use this or User message, not both.

set_state.name: Set state
